import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { SalesService } from 'src/app/services/sales.service'; interface Sale { id: number; itemName: string; buyer: string; delivered: boolean; orderStatus: string; orderDate: Date; shippedDate?: Date; deliveredDate?: Date; trackingNumber?: string; shippingAddress?: string; price?: number; } @Component({ selector: 'app-sales', templateUrl: './sales.component.html', styleUrls: ['./sales.component.css'], }) export class SalesComponent implements OnInit { sales: Sale[] = []; filteredSales: Sale[] = []; selectedStatus = 'ALL'; searchTerm = ''; isLoading = true; // Modal properties showTrackingModal = false; showDetailsModal = false; selectedSale: Sale | null = null; trackingNumber = ''; courierPartner = ''; constructor(private salesService: SalesService) {} ngOnInit(): void { this.loadSales(); } loadSales(): void { this.isLoading = true; this.salesService.getAllSales().subscribe({ next: (data) => { this.sales = data.map((sale) => ({ ...sale, orderStatus: sale.orderStatus || (sale.delivered ? 'DELIVERED' : 'PENDING'), orderDate: sale.orderDate || new Date(), })); this.filteredSales = [...this.sales]; this.isLoading = false; }, error: (err) => { console.error('Error loading sales:', err); this.isLoading = false; this.loadSampleData(); }, }); } loadSampleData(): void { this.sales = [ { id: 1001, itemName: 'HP Victus Laptop', buyer: 'john@email.com', delivered: false, orderStatus: 'PENDING', orderDate: new Date(), price: 84999, }, { id: 1002, itemName: 'Samsung Galaxy A36', buyer: 'jane@email.com', delivered: false, orderStatus: 'SHIPPED', orderDate: new Date(), price: 33999, shippedDate: new Date(), trackingNumber: 'DTDC123456', }, { id: 1003, itemName: 'SONY Bravia TV', buyer: 'mike@email.com', delivered: true, orderStatus: 'DELIVERED', orderDate: new Date(), price: 75000, shippedDate: new Date(), deliveredDate: new Date(), }, ]; this.filteredSales = [...this.sales]; } filterByStatus(status: string): void { this.selectedStatus = status; this.applyFilters(); } filterSales(): void { this.applyFilters(); } applyFilters(): void { let filtered = [...this.sales]; // Filter by status if (this.selectedStatus !== 'ALL') { filtered = filtered.filter( (sale) => sale.orderStatus === this.selectedStatus, ); } // Filter by search term if (this.searchTerm) { const term = this.searchTerm.toLowerCase(); filtered = filtered.filter( (sale) => sale.id.toString().includes(term) || sale.itemName.toLowerCase().includes(term) || sale.buyer.toLowerCase().includes(term), ); } this.filteredSales = filtered; } updateStatus(orderId: number, status: string): void { const confirmMessage = status === 'SHIPPED' ? 'Mark this order as Shipped?' : status === 'DELIVERED' ? 'Mark this order as Delivered?' : 'Cancel this order?'; if (confirm(confirmMessage)) { this.salesService.updateOrderStatus(orderId, status).subscribe({ next: (updatedSale) => { const index = this.sales.findIndex((s) => s.id === orderId); if (index !== -1) { this.sales[index] = updatedSale; this.applyFilters(); } alert( `Order ${status === 'SHIPPED' ? 'shipped' : status === 'DELIVERED' ? 'delivered' : 'cancelled'} successfully!`, ); }, error: (err) => { console.error('Error updating status:', err); alert('Failed to update order status'); }, }); } } addTrackingNumber(sale: Sale): void { this.selectedSale = sale; this.trackingNumber = ''; this.courierPartner = ''; this.showTrackingModal = true; } saveTrackingNumber(): void { if (!this.trackingNumber) { alert('Please enter a tracking number'); return; } const fullTracking = this.courierPartner ? `${this.courierPartner}: ${this.trackingNumber}` : this.trackingNumber; this.salesService .addTrackingNumber(this.selectedSale!.id, fullTracking) .subscribe({ next: (updatedSale) => { const index = this.sales.findIndex( (s) => s.id === this.selectedSale!.id, ); if (index !== -1) { this.sales[index] = updatedSale; this.applyFilters(); } this.closeTrackingModal(); alert('Tracking number added successfully!'); }, error: (err) => { console.error('Error adding tracking:', err); alert('Failed to add tracking number'); }, }); } viewOrderDetails(sale: Sale): void { this.selectedSale = sale; this.showDetailsModal = true; } closeTrackingModal(): void { this.showTrackingModal = false; this.selectedSale = null; this.trackingNumber = ''; this.courierPartner = ''; } closeDetailsModal(): void { this.showDetailsModal = false; this.selectedSale = null; } // ✅ FIXED: Handle undefined values getStatusClass(status: string | undefined): string { const statusValue = status || 'PENDING'; switch (statusValue) { case 'PENDING': return 'status-pending'; case 'SHIPPED': return 'status-shipped'; case 'DELIVERED': return 'status-delivered'; case 'CANCELLED': return 'status-cancelled'; default: return 'status-pending'; } } // ✅ FIXED: Handle undefined values getStatusText(status: string | undefined): string { const statusValue = status || 'PENDING'; switch (statusValue) { case 'PENDING': return '⏳ Pending'; case 'SHIPPED': return '🚚 Shipped'; case 'DELIVERED': return '✅ Delivered'; case 'CANCELLED': return '❌ Cancelled'; default: return '⏳ Pending'; } } formatPrice(price: number): string { return price?.toLocaleString('en-IN') || '0'; } }
